scope: isolated original-donor plus sparse physical-diffusion moving nodal content stages; prescribed transports, not solved momentum or a production factory
geometry: r-star endpoint eta rate is minus the sum of the same original layer-face divergence; relative internal vertical flux uses that rate and reference nodal fractions, retaining the bottom residual; use actual old and endpoint area times thickness, never old nodal weight as the concentration denominator
stage: one Euler stage combines original donor advection, positive coalesced diffusion and symmetric limited negative-edge exchange; donor outgoing volume plus positive diffusion outgoing coefficient obeys the original 0.5 stage ceiling; low state is bounded with the endpoint mass; shared anti-flux limiters use local graph neighborhoods including transport neighbors
sources: prescribed finite wet heat-content rate deposited after the conservative exchanges but in the same Euler update; local allowed concentration bounds shift only by that independently applied source divided by endpoint mass; dimensional heat ledger uses rho0 cp times the summed deposited content, no residual clipping or normalization by initial stock
time: SSP Heun recomputes geometry and diffusion at each Euler stage and averages original and twice-Euler content and mass; intermediate geometry is checked and any failed stage returns original surface/content; constant concentration and volume continuity checked at actual endpoint mass
tests: float64 CPU then actual CUDA; constant field, nonnegative pulse, signed random field, dry sentinels in one executable; independent NumPy donor flux assembly plus per-node moving mass and local/total source ledger64eps; reject invalid geometry, closed-face flux, nonfinite source or original joint CFL; smooth prescribed transport-only time ratios3.5..4.5 against independent fine-step reference before any full-model claim
retention: archive first failures and frozen source hashes; no production source change, API/default promotion, new-state restart migration or rerun/relabel of earlier actual rejected integrations
not_qualified: dynamic moving-face overlap, momentum pressure-work or total energy, minmod multidimensional monotonicity, hard convection gradients, ice, real1degree7/30day, century/climate/forecast or industrial comparator
